summary: PR 686 correctly fixes the concrete YAML-metadata false-positive regression in the final-ISA analyzer and preserves the prior parser fixes. It is a valid partial implementation of issue 515's ISA-analysis workflow, not a complete implementation of the original six-part low-level-control request.

tests.what_was_measured: Original-base failing-before: the analyzer feature is absent and importing it raises ModuleNotFoundError.

tests.command: analyze retained gfx950-final-isa.s on parent candidate b0d6d33d6256a013e0a5ba4a4f0a5308998ee954
tests.what_was_measured: Reproduced the review counterexample: 35 instructions, including seven YAML scalar values misclassified as opcodes.

tests.command: independent analyze_isa adversarial script plus retained compiler-emitted gfx950 assembly
tests.what_was_measured: The real assembly reports exactly 28 instructions with no YAML scalar opcodes; multiple blocks, delimiter variants, commented delimiters, and instruction-looking metadata were handled correctly.
Two tests passed on MI350X/gfx950, including optimized GPU numerical agreement with a portable GPU reference and final-ISA generation assertions.

gpu_execution_evidence: reports/j-91ddfb4a2045/raw/gpu-tests.log records two passing tests; architecture.log identifies AMD Instinct MI350X/gfx950.
remaining_counterexamples: Physical VGPR/SGPR pinning or named register-region reservation remains unimplemented.
Exact hand-scheduled region preservation and MFMA co-execute-window assertions remain unimplemented.
The requested first-class AMD instruction helpers remain unimplemented.
The requested exact low-level buffer load/store API remains unimplemented.
The requested compiler-option sweep example remains unimplemented.
remaining_limitations: The candidate implements only the final-ISA analysis portion of the original feature request.
Static ISA analysis does not prove scheduling guarantees, physical register placement, cycle timing, dependency correctness, occupancy, or handwritten-kernel performance parity.
Only AMD Instinct MI350X/gfx950 hardware was available; other CDNA and RDNA architectures were not tested.
No native rebuild was applicable because the candidate changes only Python, tests, documentation, and reports.
Direct upstream issue API access was blocked by the ROCm organization's fine-grained-token lifetime policy.
